2609.23553.title: Modeling Clinical Workflow for SYNTAX Scoring from Coronary Angiography Videos
2609.23553.paper_summary: The SYNTAX score is a clinically established tool for assessing anatomical lesion complexity in coronary artery disease and guiding subsequent treatment. However, automated SYNTAX scoring is commonly formulated as a direct regression problem from coronary angiography videos to patient-level scores. In this work, we reformulate SYNTAX scoring as a vessel segment identity-preserving anatomical reasoning problem and propose a hierarchical modeling framework that explicitly aligns learning with the clinical workflow. Our approach maintains vessel segment identity across frames and views, estimates stenosis severity at the segment level, and aggregates evidence hierarchically according to coronary anatomy. Simultaneously, to address the scarcity of domain-specific data, we integrate and complete multiple public coronary angiography datasets, constructing a large-scale resource featuring completed vessel segmentation and derived structural annotations. Experiments demonstrate that vessel segment-level stenosis embedding enhances explanatory power and reduces prediction variability compared to baseline models, with the R^2 score improving by 0.201 and dev STD decreasing by 18.4%. These results highlight the necessity of structure-aligned modeling for reliable and stable automated SYNTAX scoring from multi-view coronary angiography videos. The GitHub link is https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777.
2609.23553.paper_summary_zh: SYNTAX 分數是一種臨床上確立的工具，用於評估冠狀動脈疾病中的解剖病變複雜性並指導後續治療。<lb/>然而，自動化的 SYNTAX 計分通常被表述為從冠狀動脈造影視頻到患者級別分數的直接回歸問題。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們將 SYNTAX 計分重新表述為一個保持血管段身份的解剖推理問題，並提出一個層次建模框架，明確將學習與臨床工作流程對齊。<lb/>我們的方法在幀和視圖之間保持血管段身份，估計段級別的狹窄嚴重性，並根據冠狀動脈解剖學層次聚合證據。<lb/>同時，為了解決領域特定數據的稀缺性，我們整合並補全多個公共冠狀動脈造影數據集，構建一個大型資源，具有完整的血管分割和衍生的結構註釋。<lb/>實驗表明，血管段級別的狹窄嵌入增強了解釋能力，並減少了與基線模型相比的預測變異性，R^2 分數提高了 0.201，標準差降低了 18.4%。<lb/>這些結果突顯了結構對齊建模在從多視角冠狀動脈造影視頻中進行可靠且穩定的自動化 SYNTAX 計分的必要性。<lb/>GitHub 連結是 https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777。
